source: DESIGN.md gate table: Phase 2 begins at pressure >= 5 kPa. A physical threshold: never scaled by pace or group size (invariant I-1). It unlocks the atmospheric processor and the super-greenhouse emitter (machine-priorities rows 3 and 4; both are loads with no Index rate yet). Tubes do not exist yet.
